name: Fidget spinner
definition: a handheld or finger spinner, or spinner ring, made to be spun for fidgeting
notes: split from E1.7.4.03; shops list Spinning Fidgets / Fidget Spinners

name: Pop-it push-pop fidget
definition: a silicone board or keychain of push-in bubbles made to be popped and flipped for fidgeting
notes: split from E1.7.4.03; shops list Pop Fidgets / Pop It Fidget Toys

name: Squishy toy
definition: a soft, slow-rising squeeze toy shaped as a food, fruit or animal, sold as a squishy
notes: split from E1.7.4.03; shop sells Squishy collections by style (food, animal, packs)

name: Water blaster
definition: a toy gun, pump blaster or soaker that squirts water
notes: split from E1.7.1.05; shop lists Super Soaker / Water Pistols; second shop headed Water Shooters
